title: Module A: History of Punjab - Mock Test

questions.q: Which Guru formalized the Gurmukhi script?
questions.explanation: Guru Angad Dev Ji standardized the Gurmukhi script.

questions.q: The Manji system was established by which Guru to effectively preach Sikhism?
questions.explanation: Guru Amar Das Ji established the Manji system (22 dioceses).

questions.q: Match the Guru with the city founded: Guru Ram Das Ji.
questions.explanation: Guru Ram Das Ji founded Ramdaspur, later known as Amritsar.

questions.q: In which year was the compilation of the Adi Granth completed?
questions.explanation: Guru Arjan Dev Ji completed the compilation in 1604.

questions.q: The concept of Miri and Piri was introduced by which Guru?
questions.explanation: Guru Hargobind Ji introduced Miri and Piri.

questions.q: What was the original name of Anandpur Sahib?
questions.explanation: Anandpur Sahib was founded by Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji as Chakk Nanaki.

questions.q: In which year was the Khalsa Panth created by Guru Gobind Singh Ji?
questions.explanation: The Khalsa was created in 1699.

questions.q: Which was the first major battle fought by Guru Gobind Singh Ji?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Bhangani (1688) was the first major battle.

questions.q: What was the capital of the first sovereign Sikh state established by Banda Singh Bahadur?
questions.explanation: Banda Singh Bahadur made Lohgarh his capital.

questions.q: Who abolished the Zamindari system and gave land rights to the tillers in Punjab?
questions.explanation: Banda Singh Bahadur abolished the Zamindari system.

questions.q: Who organized the fragmented Sikh forces into the Dal Khalsa in 1748?
questions.explanation: Nawab Kapur Singh organized the Dal Khalsa.

questions.q: Who was the founder of the Sukerchakia Misl?
questions.explanation: Charat Singh founded the Sukerchakia Misl.

questions.q: In which year did Ranjit Singh capture Lahore from the Bhangi Sardars?
questions.explanation: Ranjit Singh captured Lahore in 1799.

questions.q: According to the Treaty of Amritsar (1809), which river was fixed as the boundary?
questions.explanation: Sutlej was established as the boundary.

questions.q: Who was the famous Sikh general who died defending the fort of Jamrud in 1837?
questions.explanation: Hari Singh Nalwa died at Jamrud.

questions.q: Who trained Maharaja Ranjit Singh's cavalry?
questions.explanation: Jean-François Allard trained the cavalry.

questions.q: Which treaty resulted in the establishment of a British Resident in Lahore?
questions.explanation: The Treaty of Bhairowal established a British Resident.

questions.q: Which battle of the Second Anglo-Sikh War is famously known as the 'Battle of Guns'?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Gujrat is known as the Battle of Guns.

questions.q: Who was the Governor-General of India when Punjab was annexed?
questions.explanation: Lord Dalhousie annexed Punjab.

questions.q: What was the exact date of the annexation of Punjab by the British?
questions.explanation: Punjab was annexed on 29 March 1849.

questions.q: Who was the founder of the Namdhari (Kuka) Movement?
questions.explanation: Baba Ram Singh founded the Kuka movement.

questions.q: Where was the Ghadar Party founded in 1913?
questions.explanation: The Ghadar Party was founded in San Francisco.

questions.q: Who chartered the Japanese ship Komagata Maru in 1914?
questions.explanation: Baba Gurdit Singh chartered the ship.

questions.q: What was the exact date of the Jallianwala Bagh Massacre?
questions.explanation: The massacre occurred on 13 April 1919.

questions.q: Which organization was founded by Bhagat Singh in 1926?
questions.explanation: Bhagat Singh founded the Naujawan Bharat Sabha.
